mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE file_lineage(file_id, first_registered_at) AS ( SELECT file_id, created_at FROM dataset_file WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND version_count = 1 AND previous_file_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT next_file.file_id, lineage.first_registered_at FROM dataset_file next_file JOIN file_lineage lineage ON next_file.previous_file_id = lineage.file_id WHERE next_file.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ) SELECT entry.*, creator.user_id AS creator_user_id, creator.username AS creator_username, updater.user_id AS updater_user_id, updater.username AS updater_username, lineage.first_registered_at FROM dataset_file entry LEFT JOIN file_lineage lineage ON lineage.file_id = entry.file_id LEFT JOIN auth_user creator ON creator.user_key = entry.created_by LEFT JOIN auth_user updater ON updater.user_key = entry.updated_by WHERE entry.is_deleted = FALSE
